title: SREV-124 SbieApi ioctl close request boundary

close_request.description: SbieApi_Ioctl(NULL) is a terminal close request

handle_lifetime.description: Cached driver handle is closed when present and invalidated after close

normal_ioctl.description: Non-null ioctl path preserves existing trace open remap and ioctl topology

contracts: SbieApi_Ioctl NULL parms is a close request used by kmdutil
null close request closes cached SbieApi_DeviceHandle when it exists
null close request returns before trace open or device ioctl logic can read parms zero or reopen the driver device
null close request reports NtClose status when a handle existed otherwise STATUS_SUCCESS
non-null request preserves trace driver-open STATUS_SERVER_DISABLED remap hook-bypass and ioctl topology
